full_page.content:
1928, November
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 47 Cont.
Nov. 28 (Anthony Chipus) n. cath. had been living in. .. . ! ! and danger asked to pray for him 3 weeks ago. O.K. Converted.
Robert Elart 29 - Very fine young - Expected to marry soon - Heart trouble - to Califor'a
Miss Fern McG. Teacher
Mrs. Moran - Operation Averted two weeks ago - very anxious - fearing her little ones - orphans. Deo Gratias O.K.
Ned Harrington, Peterborough, Ont. - fearful goiter - here To-day.
Page 48 Dec. 5 H. Van Huye - Halfway, Mich. (40) Cripple with Rhumatism and wife also helpless with same.
Mrs. Goldstein - Jewish - again Christof - Trial Thursday 6th Miss Mueller - Dentists daughter
Mrs. Normundeau - Tumor on Brain - Suffering 2 yrs - went to Boston for operation - came back without it. Two weeks Enrolled and got blessing - before reaching home in Windsor tumor seems to have broken and terrible pains are gone - pray for perfect cure. Jos. Galligher 12 lost his heel by snaping turtle - Doctors gave up. - is O.K.
Mrs. Eisen now in Hospital - Operation To-day Cancer of Stomach in Hospit .- Agnes Wilson, Bridgport Conn. - Tumor to be operated.
Page 49 Dec. 12 Mrs. Knapp again Sister Joseph M. Edw'ds - Shannon Thomass Roe - serious operation in Providence Hospital . ...
